Four pool companies came out. Zero gave a ballpark.

Homeowners hate that. Same for plumbers, electricians, HVAC.

If your site can't answer price range, towns you cover, and a tap-to-call number, callers bounce to the next name.

Ballpark beats silence.

drafts.text:
People with money still can't find a trades shop online.

They post in groups. They ask friends. They wait.

If Google and AI search can't match your name to the job and the town, you never get the call.

Own the page. Own the photos. Own the towns.

drafts.text:
Hiring an electrician?

Ask for a ballpark before they load the truck.

Scope of work.
Rough price range.
What's included vs extras.

A clear estimate saves both of you a wasted trip. Licensed shops can give one.
drafts.pattern: Home-service quote pain (mhp_guy pool companies, ~98k) flipped into a Baton Rouge electrician tip for homeowners
drafts.video_tip: Sister on camera, 10 seconds: 'Ask for a ballpark before we roll.' Van or panel in the background.
drafts.best_time_ct: no clear pattern in this window (no electric_4u / Fat_Electrician / mikeroweworks originals cleared 5k)

drafts.text:
Ground wire vs neutral ⚡

Neutral carries current back under normal use.
Ground sits waiting for a fault, so metal cases don't become live.

They meet at the panel. Mixing them elsewhere is a code and safety problem.

Licensed work keeps that straight.

drafts.video_tip: Close-up of a 3-prong outlet or open box, finger pointing at the ground screw. 5-second vertical. No music.
